title: “YAKUZA V2” DRAGON HANDBAG
body_html:
Inspired by traditional Japanese artistry and reimagined through a contemporary silhouette, the “Yakuza V2” Handbag combines premium craftsmanship with bold visual storytelling. Constructed from indigo raw denim and finished with genuine leather trims, the bag features an intricate golden dragon embroidery that wraps across the front, creating a striking contrast against the deep denim base.

Designed for versatility, it can be carried by the structured top handles or worn crossbody using the adjustable leather strap. Functional leather belt detailing and premium metal hardware complete the design, balancing utility with elevated aesthetics.

Whether paired with relaxed tailoring, oversized denim, or monochrome fits, the Yakuza V2 stands out as a statement accessory without compromising everyday practicality.

title: Sculpted Ivory Sneaker
body_html:
Sculpted rather than designed, this silhouette blurs the line between footwear and object. Defined by its rounded proportions, oversized lace system and monochromatic ivory finish, it embodies a quiet confidence that rewards closer inspection.

Selected for its architectural form rather than the name behind it, this piece belongs in wardrobes built around silhouette, texture and restraint. It pairs effortlessly with relaxed tailoring, oversized shirting and wide-leg denim, becoming the anchor of a considered uniform.

Details

  • Premium leather upper
  • Sculptural oversized outsole
  • Tonal ivory finish
  • Oversized lace system
  • Cushioned interior
  • Rubber outsole

title: Ministry “Jesus Built My Horses” Graphic Tee
body_html:
Not every graphic tee earns a place in the rotation.

This MINISTRY piece combines oversized proportions with an unapologetic automotive graphic and cult-favorite slogan work. A wearable conversation starter that sits at the intersection of car culture and contemporary streetwear.

The rear carries the phrase:

“NO MAN WITH A GOOD CAR NEEDS TO BE JUSTIFIED.”

Finished in a relaxed oversized silhouette, it’s the kind of piece that does all the talking.

title: Playing Cards Embroidered Baggy Denim
body_html:
Make a statement with these oversized light-wash denim jeans, designed for those who appreciate bold details and effortless silhouettes. Featuring premium embroidered playing card motifs scattered throughout the leg, this piece blends vintage-inspired denim with streetwear attitude. The relaxed wide-leg fit creates a dramatic drape, while the intricate red and black embroidery adds texture, contrast, and individuality from every angle.

Whether paired with oversized tees, hoodies, or statement footwear, these jeans are built to stand out without trying too hard.

Details

  • Light-wash denim construction
  • Oversized baggy fit
  • All-over embroidered playing card motifs
  • Red and black contrast embroidery
  • Wide-leg silhouette with stacked effect
  • Mid-rise waist
  • Durable heavyweight denim
  • Unisex design

title: RECONSTRUCTED MARILYN MONROE TEE
body_html:
The Monroe Tee reconstructs one of fashion’s most enduring icons through contrasting panels, faded portrait imagery, and archival-inspired graphics.

Cut in a relaxed boxy silhouette with dropped shoulders and a wide body, it sits effortlessly over denim, cargos, or layered tailoring. The washed tones, exposed graphic placement, and unconventional panel construction give it the character of a piece that feels discovered rather than manufactured.

title: HALF-LIGHT DENIM
body_html:
The Half-Light Denim exists somewhere between two worlds — one washed in pale sun, the other aged by time. A deliberate split construction transforms an everyday staple into something far less predictable, creating a silhouette that feels familiar from a distance and entirely different up close.

Cut with a relaxed wide-leg profile, the piece falls effortlessly through the leg, allowing the contrasting washes to speak for themselves. The drawstring waist introduces an unexpected utility detail, softening the structure while adding comfort to the equation.

This is not denim for those looking to blend into the background. It is denim for the collector who understands that the strongest pieces often live in contradiction.

title: The ACNE Gym Bro Tee
body_html:
A heavyweight statement piece that merges vintage athletic aesthetics with contemporary luxury. Rendered in a deep washed-brown tone, this oversized tee features raised leather-style appliqué lettering across the chest, paired with a distressed weightlifting graphic and tonal script detailing. The result is a rich mix of texture, depth, and character that feels both nostalgic and elevated.

Designed with a relaxed silhouette and structured drape, it’s the kind of piece that stands confidently on its own or layered over shirting for a more directional look.

title: Technical Alpine Carabiner Boot – Ash Grey
body_html:
A rugged Heliot outdoor silhouette reimagined through a contemporary lens. Crafted with a premium suede upper and reinforced panel construction, this technical boot balances utilitarian function with elevated design.

Featuring extended hiking laces, metal hardware detailing, and a heavy-duty lug sole, it delivers a distinctive statement while maintaining everyday versatility. The soft ash-grey finish offers a refined alternative to traditional black footwear, pairing effortlessly with cargos, denim, technical outerwear, and relaxed tailoring.

Details
• Premium suede and reinforced panel construction
• Extended lace system with metal eyelets
• Padded high-top collar for enhanced comfort
• Durable lug outsole with aggressive traction
• Technical outdoor-inspired design
• Ash Grey colourway

Designed for those who appreciate functional aesthetics, modern utility and understated statement pieces.

title: STUART WEITZMAN AUGUSTINE BOOT
body_html:
A modern western silhouette refined through a luxury lens.

The Augustine Boot by Stuart Weitzman combines polished leather construction with a sharp square toe and sculpted block heel, creating a striking balance between classic craftsmanship and contemporary edge. Its sleek mid-calf profile and glossy finish make it an effortless statement piece, whether paired with relaxed denim, tailored trousers, or elevated streetwear.

Details

* Premium polished leather upper
* Square toe design
* Sculpted block heel
* Side zip closure
* Mid-calf silhouette
* Leather lining and sole

Color: Black

A timeless investment boot that moves seamlessly between casual and elevated styling.

title: BAD BLOOD STUDIOS LOUNGE PANTS
body_html:
The Bad Blood Studios Lounge Pants are cut in a wide, easy silhouette and finished in a crisp off-white fabric with fine black pinstripes. Designed with an elasticated waistband and subtle branding details, the piece balances comfort and structure, making it equally suited for laid-back days and elevated styling.

The flowing fit creates a strong shape without feeling restrictive, while the striped pattern adds depth and visual texture. Pair with oversized tees, knitwear, or lightweight shirting for an effortless look.

title: Bape WGM Patent Black/Red
body_html:
The BAPE STA has long stood as one of the most recognizable silhouettes to emerge from Japanese street culture, borrowing the familiar language of basketball sneakers and transforming it into something unmistakably its own. This edition doubles down on that legacy with a glossy black patent upper, bold red STA branding, shark detailing, and the iconic WGM lettering across the heel.

The contrast between the black patent finish and the sharp red accents gives the pair a graphic, almost collectible quality—equally at home with oversized denim, cargos, or a simple monochrome fit.

For those who understand streetwear history, this isn’t just footwear. It’s a reminder of an era when niche labels became global cultural symbols through identity, community, and originality.

title: HOLLYWOOD CRAVING DISTRESS TEE
body_html:
A graphic piece that feels pulled from the margins of a forgotten publication. Faded typography, fragmented visuals, and subtle distressing come together to create a tee that sits somewhere between underground culture, archival design, and worn-in nostalgia.

The oversized silhouette and raw details give it the character of a garment that’s already lived a story, while the washed cream base makes it easy to pair with vintage denim, cargos, or layered outerwear.

Not a loud statement piece. The kind of graphic tee that reveals more the longer you look at it.

Model wears M.

title: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Metallic Silver
body_html:
The Mexico 66 takes one of Onitsuka Tiger’s most recognizable designs and pushes it into statement territory with a reflective silver leather upper, contrasted by vintage-inspired cream stripes, laces, and sole detailing.

Lightweight, low-profile, and endlessly versatile, this pair sits somewhere between retro sportswear and modern fashion. The metallic finish catches attention without feeling loud, making it the kind of sneaker that elevates even the simplest outfit.

Whether paired with relaxed denim, tailored trousers, or oversized silhouettes, the Mexico 66 Metallic Silver brings a distinctive edge while remaining easy to wear.

Why We Selected It
Not every sneaker needs to be chunky or overdesigned to make an impression. This pair delivers personality through material and finish alone; a subtle standout for those who appreciate pieces that feel different without trying too hard.

title: SCULPTED FLARE TROUSERS
body_html:
A sharp reinterpretation of classic tailoring through an experimental silhouette.

The Sculpted Flare Trousers feature a structured straight fit through the thigh before expanding into a dramatic flare below the knee. Architectural panel construction and subtle utility-inspired detailing create a shape that feels both futuristic and timeless.

Designed for those who appreciate garments with presence, these trousers challenge conventional proportions while remaining surprisingly wearable when paired with oversized knits, fitted tops, or layered outerwear.

title: SUPREME RUGBY CLUB JERSEY
body_html:
A streetwear staple reimagined through the lens of classic rugby heritage.

 

This Rugby Club Jersey blends athletic influence with everyday wearability, featuring a structured collar, oversized fit, and bold graphic detailing across a heavyweight construction. Designed to stand apart from conventional tees, it brings a sense of character and history to even the simplest outfits.

Whether layered with washed denim, cargos, or relaxed tailoring, it’s the kind of piece that carries presence without demanding attention.

Built for those who appreciate the intersection of sport, culture, and streetwear.

title: STUDDED DENIM FIELD CAP
body_html: The Studded Denim Field Cap takes a classic military-inspired silhouette and reworks it through a distressed black denim finish, finished with scattered metal stud detailing throughout. The result is a piece that feels collected rather than manufactured

title: ARCHIVE EAGLE ZIP HOODIE
body_html:
A heavyweight zip hoodie finished with a vintage-inspired wash and bold all-over graphics that feel pulled from a forgotten archive.

Featuring distressed eagle artwork, faded racing influences, and worn-in detailing throughout, the Archive Eagle Zip Hoodie delivers the character of a well-traveled piece without sacrificing comfort. The relaxed silhouette and full-zip construction make it an easy layer for everyday wear, while the aged finish gives each outfit a sense of depth and individuality.

Built for those who appreciate pieces with presence, texture, and a story behind them.

Details

• Heavyweight cotton blend
• Full zip closure
• Vintage washed finish
• Distressed eagle graphics throughout
• Relaxed oversized fit
• Ribbed cuffs and hem
• Unisex

Style Notes

Pair with faded denim, cargos, or wide-leg trousers for a naturally effortless look. Strong enough to stand alone, easy enough to layer year-round.

Tug Of Looks Edit

Selected for its archival-inspired graphics, washed character, and standout silhouette. A statement hoodie that brings vintage energy into a modern wardrobe.

title: Need A Pillow Thermal Top
body_html:
A piece that feels pulled from someone’s archive.

Constructed from textured waffle-knit cotton with contrasting camouflage raglan sleeves, the Need A Pillow Thermal Top blends military influence with underground streetwear energy. The cropped silhouette and worn-in aesthetic give it the feel of a vintage find, while the graphic statement across the chest adds just enough attitude without overwhelming the piece.

Easy to layer, easy to style, and designed for those who appreciate clothing that says more through feeling than logos.

Details

  • Waffle-knit thermal construction
  • Contrasting camouflage raglan sleeves
  • Relaxed cropped fit
  • Ribbed neckline
  • Front graphic print
  • Lightweight layering piece

title: WC CHOPPERS DISTRESSED CUT-OFF TEE
body_html:
This distressed sleeveless tee carries the unmistakable West Coast Choppers identity, featuring a faded front emblem and the iconic flaming cross graphic across the back. Heavy distressing throughout the garment gives it a naturally worn character, while the washed black finish adds years of attitude and authenticity.

Designed with a relaxed cut and raw sleeveless silhouette, it’s the kind of piece that feels equally at home layered under outerwear or worn solo as the statement.

For those drawn to vintage motorcycle culture, underground graphics, and garments with real presence.

title: CARBON DRIFT UTILITY SHORTS
body_html:
The Carbon Drift Utility Shorts combine heavyweight workwear construction with a faded flame pattern woven into the fabric, creating a look that feels worn-in, intentional, and unmistakably different.

Built with utility-inspired pocketing, hammer loop detailing, and a relaxed fit, they’re designed for days that start with no plan and end with stories.

The washed brown finish gives the shorts a naturally aged character, while the tonal flame motif adds depth without overpowering the piece.

title: MR. HENRY STILL RUGBY POLO
body_html:
The MR. HENRY STILL Stripe Rugby Polo combines classic collegiate influences with contemporary streetwear proportions. Constructed with bold black-and-white horizontal stripes, a clean contrast collar, and a relaxed silhouette, it delivers an effortless balance between vintage sport and modern everyday wear.

The front features a subtle embroidered chest graphic, while the back showcases an oversized signature artwork panel that gives the piece its distinct identity. Designed for those who appreciate details that reveal themselves over time.

title: PINDEX TRACK JACKET
body_html:
The PINDEX Track Jacket blends oversized proportions with sharp contrast piping and bold sleeve branding. 

Cut with a relaxed silhouette and lightweight shell construction, it delivers that effortless “off-duty” look while still feeling structured and intentional. The high-neck zip closure and elastic hem give it a clean shape whether worn open or fully zipped.

Pairs naturally with cargos, baggy denim, track pants, or monochrome layers.

title: Pinstripe Hardware Wide Pants
body_html:
Tailoring stripped back and rebuilt for movement.
These wide-leg trousers cut a low, pleated silhouette with a dropped waist and fluid drape, anchored by subtle pinstripe detail on a deep black base. The statement sits at the waist — double S-hook hardware and studded accents replace the standard belt loop setup, giving it an industrial, archival feel.

Designed for presence. Works just as well with a fitted tee and sneakers as it does layered over boots with a cropped jacket.

Details:


Color: Black with tonal pinstripe
Fit: Wide-leg, pleated, relaxed through the thigh
Closure: Hook-and-stud waistband with belt loops
Material: Mid-weight woven — holds structure without stiffness

Why it’s here:
Picked for silhouette and hardware. Foundation piece for fits that lean architectural, street, or quiet-lux. Not basic. Not loud. Just considered.

title: Marlboro F1 Racing Jacket
body_html:
Vintage Motorsports. Modern Streetwear.

Bring 90s F1 energy to your rotation with this red, white, and black racing-inspired jacket. Built for bold looks and everyday wear, it hits the sweet spot between retro motorsports heritage and clean streetwear.

Design & Details


Colorway: Classic red and white color block with black racing stripes down the sleeves
Branding: Embroidered and printed motorsports patches on chest, sleeves, and back including “Marlboro”, “Racing”, “Michelin”, and “Arai” for authentic racewear aesthetic


Fit: Relaxed, structured fit with a stand-up collar and full-zip front. Sits at the waist for easy layering over tees, hoodies, or cargos


Finish: Faux leather material with smooth texture and subtle sheen for that vintage racing jacket look

Material & Care


Outer: Faux leather / PU leather
Lining: Smooth polyester lining for comfort
Closure: Full-length metal zipper + snap collar button
Care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Do not machine wash

Sizing: True to size. Model is wearing size L. 

---
Note: This is a fashion-inspired racing jacket. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced by Marlboro, Michelin, or Arai. All logos are used for vintage motorsports design reference only.

title: ‘Bound For Glory’ Distressed Tee
body_html:
‘Bound for Glory’ Distressed Tee

Vintage energy, modern fit. This tee takes the ‘Bound for Glory’ film graphic and gives it a washed, lived-in treatment that hits different on-body.

Why it hits:
Story on the chest: Graphic references the 1976 Hal Ashby film, with a faded dual-frame print of motorcyclists and distressed type. It reads like a real vintage find, not a fast-fashion print.


Worn-in feel out the box: Garment-washed fabric with intentional distressing at the neckline, sleeves, and hem. Soft from day one, no stiff break-in period.


Easy oversized fit: Boxy crop with dropped shoulders. Pairs clean with baggy denim, cargos, or layered under outerwear. The cut does the work.

Details:
Material: Heavyweight cotton, garment-dyed and washed
Colorway: Faded Navy / Multi graphic
Fit: Oversized, boxy crop
Graphics: Screen print with vintage wash effect
Distressing: Pre-worn detailing at neck, sleeves, hem

This is for the fits where the tee is the focal point. Throw it on with raw denim and let the wash and graphic do the rest.

title: AFGK ‘Yellow Statement’ Jacket
body_html:
This is the piece that makes the fit. A bold yellow faux leather varsity jacket with heavyweight presence and clean AFGK branding front and back.

Why it stands out:
Color that hits: High-visibility yellow that reads luxury streetwear, not costume. It’s the piece you throw on when the rest of the outfit needs to be simple.


Details done right: Oversized “A” logo on the chest, signature script embroidery, and a large back graphic with the prancing horse emblem and “A.F.G.K” in gothic lettering. Stitching is clean, buttons sit flush, no sloppy edges.


Structure + comfort: Boxy, relaxed fit with ribbed cuffs and hem. Holds shape without feeling stiff. Works layered over tees, hoodies, or even a light knit.

Details:
Material: Faux leather exterior, lined interior
Colorway: Bright Yellow / Black graphics
Fit: Oversized, drop shoulder
Features: Snap button closure, slit pockets, ribbed hem and cuffs

title: Distressed Denim Patch Beanie
body_html:
Small detail, big attitude. This distressed denim beanie is built for when you want to add edge without overthinking it.

The crown is a heavyweight ribbed knit in washed indigo, giving you that slouchy, lived-in feel from day one. The fold-over cuff is where it gets interesting: raw, frayed denim with a bold patchwork logo hit. The contrast between the clean knit and the destroyed denim is intentional — it’s messy, rebellious, and exactly what Tug Of Looks is about.

title: Gnostic Neo-Gothic Crewneck
body_html:
This washed black crewneck is built heavy and printed harder. Front hits with a distressed gargoyle graphic and “Gnostic Visionary Cell” text. Back continues the theme with “Neo-Gothic Bauharoque” and “123” in cracked white print. Sleeves are stamped with bold “RRR” graphics for that uniform feel.

The garment wash gives it a vintage, worn-in look from day one. No stiff collar, no flimsy fabric. It drapes heavy, sits boxy, and pairs clean with your cargos, leather, and boots.

This isn’t a basic crewneck. It’s for guys building a wardrobe with intent.

title: WAFFLE BECKENBAUER TRACK TOP - WONDER WHITE
body_html: It's hard to know which to love more: The high-contrast stand-up collar and cuffs, or how cosy this adidas track jacket is. Feel free to love both equally when you wear it while running errands, on a walk or even out to dinner. Made with cotton waffle, it serves up softness and comfort all around. A slim fit keeps it close, and front zip pockets let you take along whatever you need

title: Gothic Cross & Dagger Wallet Chain
body_html:
Add weight to your fit. This Gothic Cross & Dagger wallet chain is built for guys who want their accessories to have presence.

Heavy-duty stainless steel links give it a solid feel and durability that won’t tarnish or snap after a month. The centerpiece is a detailed fleur-de-lis cross pendant, paired with a dagger charm engraved with gothic lettering. Clip it to your belt loop and wallet to keep your essentials secure while adding that biker/streetwear edge to any outfit.

It’s the detail people notice when you walk past. Works with cargos, denim, leather jackets, and everything in between. If your fit is clean but missing that edge, this is it.

Details:
Material: 316L Stainless Steel, anti-tarnish finish
Length: ∼45cm total chain length
Features: Dual lobster clasps, 3D cross pendant, dagger charm, reinforced links
Color: Antique Silver
Care: Wipe with cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals

title: Silver Foam Runner Slides
body_html:
Minimal design. Maximum comfort. These metallic foam slides are built for all-day wear without compromising the fit.

The one-piece molded foam construction molds to your foot over time, giving you that broken-in feel from day one. Perforated side vents keep things breathable in Lagos heat, while the sculpted sole provides grip and cushion with every step. The metallic silver finish keeps it futuristic and easy to pair with cargos, shorts, or loungewear.

title: Light Wax Utility Pants
body_html:
Built for movement, made to stand out. These black light wax utility cargos blend techwear function with streetwear edge.

The wide-leg silhouette creates a clean drape that stacks over boots or sneakers, while the high-shine finish catches light without looking tacky. Four oversized cargo pockets + zip details give you utility without breaking the line of the fit. Elastic waist with drawcord means you get comfort and adjustability in one.

title: PLAID TRACK JACKET
body_html:
The ROSE Plaid Track Jacket blends vintage sportswear energy with a more refined streetwear feel — featuring a deep green/navy plaid pattern, contrast piping details and a relaxed structured fit designed for effortless layering.

Finished with a full zip closure and subtle embroidered chest branding, this piece works best styled naturally: over washed denim, loose trousers or everyday basics.

title: FORAMDER “12” Rugby Polo
body_html:
A heavyweight rugby-inspired polo built with a rebellious streetwear edge. The FORANDER “12” Rugby Polo features bold mustard and charcoal horizontal striping, distressed varsity-style graphics, and embroidered crest detailing that gives it a worn-in vintage energy without feeling dated.

The oversized “12” print across the front and back brings that classic team uniform aesthetic, while the structured white collar keeps the piece sharp and balanced. Designed with a relaxed fit that sits perfectly over cargos, denim, or wide-leg trousers.

title: FAR ARCHIVE DISTRESSED HAT
body_html: A washed red distressed cap featuring layered “Far From What” typography embroidery across the crown. Finished with raw-edge distressing on the brim and panels for a naturally worn-in feel.

title: New Wave Leather Pants
body_html:
Crafted in deep red leather with a subtle sheen, the cut is slim through the thigh then flares out hard from the knee down. It’s that 70s biker-meets-modern streetwear silhouette that stacks perfect over boots and makes your legs look longer. Dual angled zips on each thigh add aggression and function, while the clean back pockets keep it wearable off-stage.

The leather has weight and structure, so it holds the flare without collapsing. Pair it with a fitted black tee, your heavy boots, and a silver chain and you’ve got a full Tug Of Looks look that hits different in person.

This is a statement piece. Wear it when you want to own the night.

title: Guns N Roses Vintage Tee
body_html:
The Guns N Roses Tee brings vintage energy into a modern silhouette. Washed black base with a bold front and back print — built to stand alone or sit under heavier layers.

Curated For A Reason

title: Wrap Shades — Blackform
body_html:
Wrap Shades are built for presence — sharp, minimal, and intentional.
Designed to sit close, frame the face, and complete the look without competing for attention.

title: Panel Washed Wide-Leg Denim
body_html:
These jeans are built with a reconstructed feel—panelled sections that break the usual silhouette and create a more architectural shape. The faded blue wash carries a worn, almost sun-bleached texture, giving the piece a sense of history before it even reaches you.

Cut in a wide-leg fit, it stacks effortlessly over sneakers, creating that grounded, heavy presence without trying too hard. Subtle distressing and tonal variations across the panels add depth, making every pair feel slightly unique.

This is denim that feels collected, not just bought.

title: NEUROSIS Distressed Tee
body_html:
NEUROSIS tee leans into minimalism while carrying an underlying tension. Clean at first glance, but intentionally worn-in on closer inspection.

Crafted in a soft off-white cotton, the silhouette is relaxed with a slightly boxy drape, giving it that effortless, lived-in feel. Subtle distressing details are scattered across the body, adding texture without overpowering the design. Centered across the chest, the bold NEUROSIS typography anchors the piece. Sharp, introspective, and unapologetically raw.

body_html: By Travis x Cactus Jack Entertainment

body_html:
A sculptural slip-on finished in a vivid electric blue hair texture, designed to shift attention without trying too hard. Minimal in form, bold in presence.

Details:

  • Slip-on mule design
  • Textured hair finish
  • Structured silhouette
  • Lightweight feel
  • Statement colorway (electric blue)

Styling:
Works best when everything else is calm.
Let this carry the look.

title: MERTRA CHECK SHIRT
body_html:
This red check short sleeve shirt from MERTRA brings structure and presence to a simple fit. Designed with a slightly boxy silhouette, it sits clean on the body while still giving that relaxed, street-ready feel.

The grid pattern adds texture without being loud, making it easy to pair while still catching attention. Finished with subtle branding details on the chest and back for a quiet statement.

Perfect for everyday wear, but styled right — it becomes the centerpiece.

title: TIMBER-INSPIRED MONOGRAM BOOTS (RED)
body_html:
A bold fusion of street culture and rugged utility. These statement boots bring together classic workwear DNA with unmistakable luxury-inspired detailing — designed for those who move different.

Crafted in a rich red suede-like upper, the silhouette is elevated with a monogram canvas panel that adds texture and exclusivity to the look. Gold-tone lace hardware and rope laces give it that timeless outdoor edge, while the padded collar ensures all-day comfort.

Built on a durable black lug sole, this pair delivers both presence and practicality — whether you’re styling for the city or stepping out with intent.

title: Jceasar Vampire Slip-On
body_html: • The shoe upper is made of imported top-grain leather, offering a delicate touch and sheen. Rubber outsole with floral texture enhances comfort and durability. The square ballet shoe toe combined with the mule-style upper and handcrafted ruching elevates the design. Embossed logo on the insole, with a slip-on mule style for easy wear and a more relaxed look.

title: Minimal Black Slide Sandals
body_html:
Stripped back to the core, these black slides are designed for comfort, ease, and clean aesthetics. The sculpted strap adds subtle structure, while the cushioned footbed ensures all-day wearability.

This is the kind of piece that fits seamlessly into your lifestyle — whether you’re stepping out casually or winding down. Quiet, minimal, and intentional.

Details:

  • Soft, molded footbed for comfort
  • Wide structured strap for a secure fit
  • Lightweight and easy to wear
  • Durable sole for everyday use
  • Clean all-black finish

title: PDF Camo Lace-Up Combat Boots
body_html:
These camo combat boots blend rugged durability with a refined street aesthetic. The bold camouflage upper is balanced with a clean neutral collar and grounded by a thick, durable sole — built for both function and style.

 

Designed to hold weight visually, this pair anchors your outfit while still adding texture and personality. Whether styled casually or as part of a heavier fit, it brings controlled aggression to your look.

title: Heavy Gloss Puffer Jacket
body_html:
This high-gloss black puffer is built for presence — the kind that doesn’t ask for attention but naturally commands it. Designed with a structured silhouette and a cropped, modern fit, it delivers both warmth and edge without compromising style.

The reflective finish elevates a classic winter essential into something far more intentional — perfect for late nights, city movement, and layered fits that need a standout outer piece.

Details:

  • High-shine, water-resistant exterior
  • Insulated padding for warmth without bulk
  • Structured cropped fit
  • Full front zip closure
  • Elasticated cuffs and hem for a snug finish

title: Number Plaque Belt
body_html: Add a touch of iconic French fashion to your everyday outfits with this black belt from MM6. Crafted from premium leather with an adjustable metal buckle, it’s then detailed with the label’s iconic number motif for a refined finish.

title: MMY Studded Low Sneakers — Vintage Black
body_html:
The MMY Studded Low Sneakers blend raw edge with intentional design, sitting right at the intersection of streetwear and controlled chaos.

Crafted with a smooth black upper, the silhouette is disrupted by hand-placed metallic studs across the toe and heel—giving it that rebellious, almost industrial energy. The contrast hits harder with the off-white, distressed sole, designed to feel lived-in from day one.

White rope laces cut through the darkness, adding balance and keeping the look grounded. Every detail feels deliberate—nothing too polished, nothing accidental.

title: PUBLIC ENEMY L/S TOP
body_html:
The Public Enemy L/S Top fuses rebellious energy with bold visual storytelling. Designed with a collage of contrasting panels, each sleeve carries its own attitude: from vintage Americana motifs to target graphics and distressed typography. The front anchors it all with a raw monochrome image and the unapologetic message: “Bring the Public Enemy.”

Cut in a relaxed silhouette, this piece balances comfort with presence. The raglan-style sleeves give it that effortless streetwear edge, while the heavyweight cotton feel keeps it structured and premium.

title: SHELL DETACHABLE CARGO PANTS
body_html:
These detachable shell cargo pants push beyond standard function into full-on modular design. Built from a lightweight technical fabric, they feature multiple oversized cargo pockets, clean paneling, and zip-off sections that let you switch the silhouette on command.

Full length when you need coverage. Cropped when the fit calls for it. Same energy, different expression.

The neutral tone keeps it versatile, while the structure does all the talking. This is gear made for movement—on your terms.

title: SEASON 7 SLIDES
body_html:
The YZY S7 Slides are built for movement without noise. A fully blacked-out design keeps things minimal, while the soft, cushioned construction delivers that easy, slip-on comfort you’ll reach for daily.

Whether you’re stepping out quick or styling it into a full fit, this pair holds that understated presence—no logos screaming, just clean energy.

Lightweight. Durable. Straight to the point.

title: Protocol Index Stripe Hoodie
body_html: Protocol Index Stripe Hoodie blends collegiate energy with streetwear edge. Cut in a cropped silhouette with bold navy and red horizontal stripes, this standout piece features a contrasting grey hood, front graphic embroidery, and statement back patch detailing. Finished with ribbed hems and a relaxed fit for easy everyday layering. A rare piece built for those who move different.

title: BADBLOOD STUDIOS — Destroyed Sweats
body_html:
The Destroyed Sweats come in a washed charcoal tone with a naturally faded finish, giving each pair a worn-in, almost archival feel. Subtle distressing across the leg adds edge without trying too hard, while the oversized silhouette keeps it relaxed and effortless.

Finished with a tonal crest detail and a flowing script graphic along the leg, it carries just enough identity without overpowering the fit.

Soft, heavyweight cotton. Elastic waistband for comfort. Cut to sit loose with a slight stack.

For days when you don’t need to say much—but still want to be seen.

title: Bravest ‘HAIL MARY’ Jersey
body_html:
The Bravest “HAIL MARY” Jersey blends religious iconography with a contemporary streetwear silhouette, creating a piece that feels both symbolic and disruptive. Featuring a striking Virgin Mary graphic across the front, layered with radiant detailing and sharp contrast panels, it commands attention without saying too much.

Cut in a relaxed jersey fit, it delivers that effortless drape

title: RRR123 “Metaphysics” L/S Tee
body_html:
The RRR123 Rivington long sleeve exists somewhere between philosophy and chaos — layered graphics, distorted typography, and a narrative that feels half-decoded.

Set on a washed bone base, the front pulls you into a warped visual core surrounded by cryptic text and symbolic references. The sleeves carry bold, industrial-style prints that extend the story beyond the center.

Flip it over and it gets deeper.

A manifesto-like back print stamped with “RIVINGTON” and “WINGING IT’S WAY TOWARDS DIVINITY” reads like a coded message — raw, imperfect, intentional. The kind of piece that doesn’t explain itself fully… and doesn’t need to.

title: 8-ball Quilted Jacket
body_html: A cold-weather essential with signature streetwear character, this Stüssy quilted jacket delivers warmth without sacrificing style. Crafted in a soft sand-toned shell with diamond quilting throughout, it features a clean zip-up front, ribbed collar and cuffs in rich brown, and a relaxed fit that layers effortlessly. Functional front pockets keep things practical, while the oversized 8-ball graphic on the back adds that unmistakable Stüssy attitude. Lightweight, insulated, and easy to wear—built for everyday rotation with standout appeal.

title: Hollywood JumboLace — Teal
body_html: A refined take on the everyday sneaker, these low-top trainers balance minimalism with signature edge. Crafted in smooth muted teal leather, they feature an oversized padded tongue, chunky rope laces, and a clean rounded toe for that unmistakable contemporary silhouette. The contrast cream rubber sole adds softness and grip, while the low-cut profile keeps them versatile enough for daily wear. Sleek, elevated, and effortlessly cool—made to bring quiet statement energy to any fit.

title: MATTYBOY x CH Tee
body_html: A bold statement piece from Chrome x MATTYBOY, this vivid lime green pocket tee brings playful energy to premium streetwear. Crafted from soft heavyweight cotton, it features a clean front with a chest pocket stamped with the “Sex Records” graphic, while the back is finished with an oversized hand-drawn logo and smiley face artwork for a standout finish. Signature sleeve detailing and subtle branding at the hem add that unmistakable Chrome Hearts edge. Easy to style but impossible to ignore.

title: Mijko Carpenter Jorts
body_html: A sharp take on utility denim, these black contrast-panel shorts blend structure with streetwear attitude. Cut from sturdy washed denim, they feature a relaxed wide-leg fit with layered panel detailing that adds depth and edge without overdoing it. The faded charcoal upper meets deep black lower panels for a clean two-tone finish, while oversized side pockets bring both function and a bold silhouette. Built for everyday wear, but styled to stand out.

title: OWNERS CLUB TEE
body_html:
Cut in a relaxed, slightly boxy silhouette, this tee leans into that effortless, worn-in energy. The soft cream base sets the tone, while the deep red collegiate-style “OWNERS CLUB” print brings a sense of identity

The fabric carries a premium weight without feeling heavy, giving it structure while still draping naturally on the body. It’s the kind of tee that sits right every time you throw it on with no adjustment needed.

There’s also a subtle nod here for those who know — a signature touch from one of the UK’s most culture-shaping labels, recognized for blending luxury with everyday wear.

title: ‘LOCAL HERO’ Long Stripe Shirt
body_html:
This oversized striped polo reworks a familiar silhouette into something louder, more intentional. Cut with a relaxed, almost defiant fit, it drapes off the body with ease, blurring the line between structure and nonchalance.

The bold red base is broken up by fine horizontal striping, creating rhythm without chaos. At the center, a contrast panel stamped “LOCAL HERO” anchors the piece.

Finished with a classic collar and extended sleeves, it carries just enough familiarity to feel wearable, but enough distortion to stand apart.

title: Eye Motif Knit Sweater
body_html:
Designed with a bold central eye graphic, this piece pulls attention without forcing it. The abstract burst pattern radiates across a soft knit base, creating a visual that feels both symbolic and slightly surreal.

It’s the kind of piece that people notice… then look again. Clean from a distance. Intentional up close.

title: BULLY CUT-OFF TEE
body_html:
A captured moment tied closely to Ye’s world one that blurred the line between art and reality, and sparked quiet conversation before anything was confirmed.

This tee holds that energy.

Printed on a faded black base, the graphic hits with intensity. Finished with gothic lettering that leans into the darker tone surrounding the era.

title: Leather Flare Pants
body_html: Crafted in a high-gloss leather finish, these flare pants sit clean on the waist and fall into a subtle wide-leg break — giving that effortless silhouette that moves with presence. The shine catches light differently with every step, making it impossible to ignore, but never loud.

title: ‘Start The Rapture’ Fade Tee
body_html:
A worn-in statement that feels pulled from a different timeline.

The Saint Tee — Rapture Fade carries a raw, almost archival energy — distressed black cotton layered with bold, satirical artwork and heavy narrative text across the back. It’s not clean, not perfect — and that’s exactly the point.

The front graphic plays with contrast and tension, while the back reads like a warning, a prophecy, or something in between. Every fade, mark, and imperfection adds character, making each piece feel lived-in before it even reaches you.

title: Eps/Key Field Rugby Top
body_html:
The Field Rugby Top carries a structured, athletic silhouette softened by time — bold horizontal striping, raw edge detailing, and a slightly relaxed fit that sits naturally on the body. It feels familiar, but not ordinary.

There’s a quiet confidence in pieces like this. Nothing exaggerated, nothing forced — just strong presence through proportion, texture, and balance.

It works layered.

It works on its own.

It works without trying.

This is the kind of piece that doesn’t need explanation.
It just becomes part of how you show up.

A piece that feels lived in from day one.

Not loud. Not forced. Just intentional.

For those who understand that the smallest shifts create the strongest presence.

title: 40 Acres Spike Tee
body_html: The Men's Supreme 40 Acres Spike Tee Shirt in Whire delivers graphic impact through a clean White tee silhouette. The relaxed silhouette allows it to function effortlessly as both a shirt and a lightweight overshirt, making it a versatile statement piece for modern wardrobes.

A design that embodies Y/PROJECT’s fearless approach to reconstruction and layering.

Perfect for warm-weather layering, these shorts embody DRKSHDW’s signature balance of utility, comfort, and quiet statement.

title: 1461 Airwair 3-Eye Shoes
body_html:
These lace-up shoes are inspired by Dr. Martens' archives spanning over 60 years. The Airwair print is inspired by the shoebox design used in the mid- to late 1980s.


The upper is crafted from durable, smooth leather and features a bold Dr. Martens graphic. The
black eyelets are paired with matching round laces. A specially designed heel loop is added, and the welt is finished with iconic yellow stitching.
The 1461 3-Eye Shoe has been an iconic Dr. Martens staple for decades. Originally marketed as a durable work shoe, it quickly became a popular fashion item among political protesters and university students across the UK. Now, it's a time-honored fashion statement, beloved by a wide variety of people, from stylists to skaters, punks to poets, rockers to rude boys.

Constructed from premium heavyweight cotton, the sweatshirt delivers a structured yet relaxed silhouette, designed to hold its shape while aging beautifully over time. The monochrome embroidery and prints add depth without noise, making this a statement piece that still works effortlessly in rotation.

A TRUE COLLECTORS PIECE

title: Bad Blood Studios Stripe Shirt
body_html:
The Bad Blood Studios Stripe Shirt reworks a timeless pinstripe silhouette with bold character and subtle rebellion. Crafted in crisp white cotton with fine black stripes, the shirt features a relaxed, slightly boxy cut that drapes effortlessly on the body—easy, intentional, and understated.

The statement lives at the back: an oversized red embroidered “Bad Blood” script across the shoulders, paired with delicate graphic details that contrast sharply against the clean base. It’s expressive without being loud—meant to be noticed up close.

title: YZY Gosha Vultures L/S Shirt
body_html:
A moody relic from the “Vultures” era — washed in ecru and silence.

This long-sleeve captures the cultural tension of a moment where art, ego, and abandonment collided.

Crafted with intention, worn for presence.

Best styled: with loose trousers, clean footwear, and nonchalance.

Fit: Relaxed. Slightly oversized.

title: Saint “YOUTH” Distressed Sweat
body_html: SAINT Mxxxxxx co-founders Yuta Hosokawa and Cali Thornhill Dewitt are driven by a shared love of vintage design and their clothing is often distressed to give it a lived-in look. This sweatshirt is made from cotton-jersey, ripped, stained and screen-printed with the brand's 'Chaos' logo.

title: Mijko Washed Stacked Denim
body_html:
A modern reinterpretation of classic denim, defined by its elongated cut and heavy stacking at the hem. This pair features a soft, faded wash with natural wear lines across the thighs, giving it a broken-in, lived-with feel straight out the gate.

The straight-to-flared silhouette is intentionally long, allowing the fabric to stack effortlessly over footwear for a relaxed yet deliberate finish. Built with structured denim that holds its shape while developing character over time, these jeans balance comfort, attitude, and presence.

title: Thug Club Sculpted Tank — Grey Marl
body_html:
A precision-cut tank that blurs the line between streetwear and formwear. This THUG CLUB piece is built around structure — not graphics — using contoured panel stitching that naturally follows the body and sharpens the silhouette from every angle.

Crafted in a soft grey cotton blend, the tank features architectural seam lines across the chest and back, creating a subtle armored effect without sacrificing comfort. A minimal metal logo pin sits on the front, acting as the only branding detail — quiet, intentional, and unmistakably THUG CLUB.

Designed to be worn alone or layered, this is a statement piece for those who understand restraint.

title: Salomon RX SLIDE 3.0 SEASONAL
body_html: SEASONAL is a revisited adaptation of a Salomon classic – the recovery shoe. Created to alleviate physical stress sensations in your feet, this RX SLIDE 3.0 is a lightweight and comfortable after-sports slip-on ideal for lounging around and getting serious about relaxation. Featuring an oversized version of archival branding.

title: CB Intarsia Knit Shorts
body_html: Cole Buxton mission to redesign sportswear for everyday use is continued with these knit shorts. Made from luxurious Italian-spun Merino wool blend, it’s cut to a boxy fit - perfect for heading to the gym or laying low at home - and detailed with intarsia branding.

title: Corteiz NDA Tee
body_html:
No slogans. No explanations.

Just a graphic that speaks to those already tapped in.

The NDA Tee is cut from premium cotton with a relaxed silhouette, built for effortless wear and cultural relevance

title: Waffle Henley Long Sleeve
body_html:
This long-sleeve Henley is cut from a soft waffle-knit fabric that holds structure while staying breathable. The subtle texture adds depth without noise, making it a piece that works on its own or layered effortlessly.

Finished with a minimalist button placket and a relaxed, boxy silhouette, it sits right at the intersection of comfort and polish. The kind of essential that feels considered, not basic.

title: Leather Chelsea Heel Boots
body_html:
A refined essential built for understated confidence. These black leather Chelsea boots feature a sleek, almond-toe silhouette with a subtle stacked heel that adds just enough elevation without sacrificing comfort. Crafted from smooth, polished leather, the minimalist design is finished with elastic side panels for effortless slip-on wear and a clean, tailored look.

Designed to move seamlessly between day and night, they pair just as well with tailored trousers as they do with relaxed fits. Sharp, versatile, and timeless.

title: 6ixWas9ine X Y/Project Studded Belt
body_html: The 6ixWas9ine X Y/Project Studded Belt features layered metal hardware, bold stud detailing, and a structured leather build that instantly elevates even the simplest fit.

title: STÜSSY MID DEPTH BURLY THREADS CAP - GREY
body_html:

- Stüssy basic star logo embroidery
- Unstructured crown

title: Mascot L/S Football Top 'White'
body_html:
Sport-inspired, reworked for everyday wear. The Mascot Football Long Sleeve Top brings a classic athletic silhouette into a more expressive, street-ready form.

Cut in a relaxed fit, it features bold graphic placements across the sleeves and a standout number detail at the back — giving it that authentic team-jersey feel without being tied to any one identity.

The clean white base keeps it versatile, while the layered graphics add just enough edge to make it stand out.

Lightweight, comfortable, and easy to style.

title: THUG CLUB HOODED FLANNEL
body_html:
A signature outerwear piece from Thug Club, blending rugged flannel construction with the brand’s dark, gothic visual language. Designed to stand out while staying wearable, this hooded flannel functions as both a jacket and a statement layer.

Details

  • Blue and black plaid flannel base
  • Attached hood for a hybrid jacket–hoodie silhouette
  • Full front zip closure
  • Dagger graphic prints on sleeves and oversized triple-dagger artwork at the back
  • Chest zip pocket with metal hardware detail
  • Slightly washed finish for a worn-in, vintage feel
  • Relaxed fit suitable for layering

title: The Chronicler Crop Raglan Tee
body_html:
Every world has those who record what others forget.

The Chronicler exists to bear witness.

This cropped raglan tee is constructed as a living document — layered panels, contrast sleeves, and stitched seams working together like pages bound over time. The front and back collage prints feel archival, almost recovered, as if pulled from a record that was never meant to be complete.

Nothing here is decorative by accident. The graphics read like fragments of history, moments captured mid-collapse, preserved through fabric rather than ink.

title: Megalace Geth Runners
body_html:
A progressive runner built at the intersection of performance and design.

The Rick Owens Megalace Geth Runners feature an aggressive layered silhouette, engineered mesh upper, and signature lace webbing that wraps the shoe with a sculptural feel.

Designed for everyday wear but inspired by high-concept sportswear, the exaggerated sole delivers comfort and presence, while the monochrome palette keeps it versatile and timeless.

title: SAINT “Enemy” Tee
body_html:
A washed graphic tee that plays with contradiction — faith, conflict, and self-awareness layered into a single silhouette.

The front features a bold “Enemy” script, while the back is stamped with SAINT iconography, giving the piece a quiet but confrontational presence.

Cut in a relaxed fit with a vintage fade, this tee feels lived-in from the first wear. Designed to sit effortlessly within streetwear rotations that value meaning over noise.

title: Project G/R Double-Sided Reverse Flight Jacket
body_html:
The Project G/R Double-Sided Reverse Flight Jacket merges collegiate nostalgia with utilitarian flightwear, designed to be worn inside-out, mood-to-mood.

One side features a bold red zip-up hoodie construction with varsity-style graphics and crest detailing — expressive, youthful, and unapologetic. Reverse it to reveal a classic black padded flight jacket silhouette: minimal, functional, and quietly powerful.

Cropped proportions and exaggerated volume give the piece a modern edge, while the reversible build allows it to exist between softness and structure, street and archive, day and night.

title: Vuja De Relaxed Plaid Overshirt
body_html:
A modern take on classic plaid, cut with intention.

This overshirt features a boxy, relaxed silhouette that sits slightly cropped for a contemporary profile. Crafted from a soft, mid-weight fabric, it balances structure with ease — easy to layer, easy to wear, but far from ordinary.

The muted blue-green check keeps it understated, while the dropped shoulders and roomy body give it that effortless, off-duty feel. Wear it buttoned up for a clean statement or open over a tee for a laid-back look.

Details

  • Relaxed, boxy fit
  • Slightly cropped length
  • Soft mid-weight fabric
  • Button front closure
  • Designed for layering across seasons

title: Number Plaque Distressed Knit Cardigan
body_html:
MM6 Number Plaque Cardigan. Softly structured knit cardigan designed for understated layering. Crafted in a textured ash-grey yarn with subtle distressing at the cuffs and hem, this piece carries quiet character rather than loud branding.

The relaxed fit allows it to drape naturally over tanks, tees, or shirting, while the button-front closure keeps it versatile across seasons.

title: Hooked Embroidered Denim Pants
body_html:
A reworked take on classic denim, designed with intentional hardware and subtle detailing.

Crafted from washed blue denim, this piece features a straight-to-slight flare silhouette with metal hook fastenings at the front, adding a utilitarian edge to an otherwise timeless form. Finished with tonal embroidery at the lower legs, the details reveal themselves quietly rather than loudly.

title: ‘Lord Of Darkness’ Geo-Basket
body_html: Aptly nicknamed The Lord of Darkness, The RO geo-basket brings gothic and industrial inspiration to avant-garde design. Crafted in Italy from soft and lightweight leather, the Jumbolace Geobasket sneakers feature zippers on the inside for easy closure.

title: Derschutze Garden Of Eden Zip Up
1017 9SM Phantom Zip-Up Shirt
body_html:
A different take on the short sleeve shirt.

Zip front instead of buttons.

Relaxed fit, clean structure.

Lightweight feel with just enough edge.

title: Lips Motif Penny Loafers
body_html:
A reimagination of classic footwear through a modern, expressive lens. Known for blending traditional British shoemaking with playful, graphic details, the brand creates pieces that feel familiar  yet never predictable.

These penny loafers are crafted in smooth black leather and finished with a contrasting white vamp, stamped with DD’s signature hand-painted lips motif. The result is a quiet clash of formality and irreverence: a classic silhouette disrupted just enough to feel current.

This is footwear for those who understand that style lives in the details.

title: Legacy Grafitti Sweatpants
body_html:
REPRESENT has always blurred the line between luxury and lived-in culture. Founded in the UK, the brand is known for translating personal history, street references, and archival graphics into refined everyday silhouettes. The Legacy Graffiti Sweatpants are a direct expression of that philosophy.

Rendered in a soft cream base, these sweatpants are covered in hand-drawn, tattoo-style illustrations — eagles, script, flames, figures, insignias — layered like a visual diary. Each graphic feels collected over time, not placed for symmetry. The result is controlled chaos: expressive, but deliberate.

Cut with a relaxed straight-leg profile, the pants balance comfort with presence. They’re made to be worn slowly — styled with matching tops or used as a statement against simpler pieces.

This isn’t just loungewear.

It’s memory, attitude, and craft stitched into one garment.

title: Off good Tate Pleater Jacket
body_html:
OFFGOD doesn’t chase trends or seasonal approval; its language is rooted in subculture, symbolism, and quiet rebellion. Pieces are designed to be decoded, not explained.

This track jacket reimagines adidas’ athletic DNA through OFFGOD’s experimental lens. Constructed in premium faux leather, the surface is embossed with abstract, almost anatomical forms — subtle from afar, intentional up close. The signature three stripes in muted yellow cut clean lines down the sleeves, balancing sport heritage with avant-garde expression.

At the back, a raised graphic merges OFFGOD iconography with the adidas trefoil — a mark of collaboration without shouting. It’s a jacket built for those who understand restraint as power.

title: Telfar 2005 Thermal Sweatshirt
body_html:
Rooted in history. Built for everyone.

The Telfar 2005 Thermal Sweatshirt pulls from early-2000s collegiate sportswear and filters it through Telfar’s unmistakable lens — democratic, understated, and quietly powerful.

Constructed from textured thermal fabric, this piece delivers warmth without bulk and character without excess. The faded “TELFAR 2005” chest graphic feels archival, almost worn-in by design, reinforcing the brand’s anti-exclusivity stance while still carrying cultural weight.

title: CACTUS JACK / EARTHQUAKER SHORTS
body_html:
Official merchandise released to coincide with the release of Travis Scott's new album, "UTOPIA."

These denim shorts feature prints on the thighs and back waist, and UTOPIA embroidery on the coin pocket.

title: Navy Academy Rugby Shirt
body_html:
The Navy Academy Rugby Shirt blends classic collegiate structure with bold street expression — finished in a deep navy base with red panel detailing and heavyweight embroidery that commands attention without shouting.

Designed with a traditional rugby collar and relaxed silhouette, this piece sits comfortably between vintage sportswear and modern street culture. The oversized crest and ATL-inspired graphics give it presence, while the long sleeves and durable cotton construction make it a seasonless essential.

title: Project G/R  FW25 “PROTOCOL INDEX” Hoodie
body_html:
A reconstructed statement piece built from mixed military-inspired panels, the Protocol Index Hoodie blends nostalgia, grit, and modern street culture.

Cut from heavyweight fleece with intentional distressing, contrast sleeves, and layered graphics, it feels like something pulled out of an archive — reimagined for FW25.

Every sleeve tells a different story: naval insignias on one arm, bold Americana prints on the other, and a frontal “ARMY” stamp anchoring the design. Finished with a textured embroidered chest patch and subtle destruction around the seams.

A collectors’ hoodie for the ones who lean toward culture.

title: Tear-away Wide Leg Pusher Pants
body_html: A relaxed wide-leg pant cut from washed heavyweight cotton and finished with full side snap closures. The extended length creates a clean stacked effect, while the muted stone-beige wash keeps it versatile and refined. A modern street-lux essential designed for daily wear.

title: AntidoteWorldwide SS/23 Mythology Revere Shirt
body_html:
Antidote presents this black shirt as part of their
Spring/Summer '23 collection. 

Iconography from another dimension, printed on satin-like flow.

title: BadBlood Mystic Capsule Rugby Shirt
body_html:
Sportswear rewritten with myth and attitude.

The Mystic Capsule Rugby is built like a classic, but nothing about it feels traditional.

The bold BADBLOOD arc embroidery, the stitched insignias, the number patches, the crest — everything is placed with intention, giving the shirt the feel of a uniform from a team that never existed… but somehow should have.

It carries nostalgia, rebellion, and that quiet “if you know, you know” confidence that defines the BadBlood universe.

Details

  • Heavyweight black rugby knit
  • Contrasting white collar
  • Red BADBLOOD centerpiece embroidery
  • Signature “91” patch + winged emblem
  • Mystic Capsule crest detailing
  • Relaxed, slightly oversized cut

title: Stussy x Dries Van Noten Patch Knit Sweater 'Sand'
body_html:
A collaboration between Stüssy’s global street legacy and Dries Van Noten’s avant-garde precision, built on a warm sand knit base and finished with a curated set of patches that feel archival, symbolic, and intentional.

The result is a wearable artifact: part street, part runway, entirely its own world.

Details

  • Heavyweight textured knit in sand
  • Mixed embroidered patches with symbolic artwork
  • Relaxed V-neck silhouette
  • Dropped shoulders for a laid-back drape
  • Collaborative detailing from Stüssy + Dries Van Noten

 

Style Notes

Layer over a collared shirt or wear it solo — the patches carry enough narrative on their own. Works seamlessly with cargos, denim, or tailored wide-legs.

title: Love Of Sunset x Cactus Plant Flea Market
body_html: Introducing the SAINT Mxxxxxx brand, known for its innovative designs and boundary-pushing collaborations. Fall/Winter 2024 brings us the Love Of Sunset x Cactus Plant Flea Market Camiseta de Manga Corta in Verde. This highly anticipated collaboration combines the unique aesthetics of both designers, resulting in a vibrant and eclectic piece that is sure to turn heads. Whether you're a fan of graphic tees or simply appreciate wearable art, this Camiseta de Manga Corta is a must-have for your collection.

title: Desert Camo Emblem Shorts
body_html:
Built on a desert-tone camo base, these shorts carry stitched emblems that feel collected, not added — signals from different worlds sitting on the same canvas. Each patch introduces its own energy, giving the piece a lived-in, curated feel.

Details

 

  • Alternate desert camo pattern
  • Mixed embroidered emblems
  • Mid-thigh cut
  • Soft, breathable fabric
  • Versatile silhouette for everyday wear

 

Style Notes

Pair with a washed tee or a clean black top to let the emblems speak. Works effortlessly with sneakers or slides.

title: Silk-Satin Durag “Snow”
body_html:
for the nights you want your look to speak without saying anything.

“Snow” is a high-sheen, cold-tone durag crafted from premium silk-satin for smooth compression and clean lines. Whether you’re laying waves or elevating your fit, this piece holds its ground.

title: Bad Blood Studios Tartan Rugby Shirt
body_html:
The Bad Blood Tartan Rugby Shirt blends preppy heritage with underground attitude — a collision of classic rugby silhouettes and the graphic-forward identity that has made Bad Blood a cult name in contemporary streetwear.

Cut in a deep red tartan with contrast brown details, the piece is decorated with vintage-inspired cigar–style patches and typography, giving it a lived-in, Americana feel without losing its modern edge. The back features oversized branding that feels more like a poster than a print — a visual signature of the label’s bold storytelling.

This is the kind of shirt that works layered, styled loose, or thrown into wide silhouettes. It’s nostalgic, but reimagined. Familiar, but with a twist only Bad Blood could pull off.

title: Acne Liquid Steel Mid-Rise Wide-Leg Jeans
body_html:
A future-classic with industrial edge.

The Mid-Rise Wide-Leg Jeans reimagine denim through a metallic, liquid-steel finish that catches light with every move. Cut in a wide, architectural silhouette, they sit mid-waist and fall into a relaxed drape that feels effortless yet undeniably directional.

A piece built for wardrobes that want presence — understated in shape, unapologetic in texture.

Details:

– Metallic coated denim finish

– Mid-rise fit

– Extra-wide leg silhouette

– Classic 5-pocket construction

– Leather patch at the back

– Structured but fluid drape

Perfect with minimalist tops, heavy boots, or anything that lets the trousers lead the conversation.

title: Oversized Sculpted Leather Shoulder Bag
body_html:
A bold, architectural silhouette designed for everyday movement. Crafted from smooth, premium faux leather with a soft structure that holds its shape, this oversized shoulder bag brings a modern edge to any outfit. The wide adjustable strap ensures a comfortable crossbody or over-shoulder carry, while the clean triangular form creates a statement without trying too hard.

Finished with a slanted exterior zip pocket for quick-access essentials, and a spacious main compartment that fits everything you actually need — from daily essentials to travel gear.

Details

  • Smooth sculpted faux leather
  • Oversized triangular silhouette
  • Adjustable wide shoulder strap
  • Exterior zip pocket
  • Soft yet structured body
  • Minimal, modern hardware

title: RCULT HAKAMA Bermuda Shorts
body_html:
A modern reinterpretation of traditional Japanese hakama silhouettes — wide, fluid, and intentionally structured.

These RCULT Bermuda shorts sit in that space between contemporary streetwear and quiet architectural design.

The exaggerated flare gives a sharp, sculptural shape when you move, while the tailored waistband keeps everything grounded and clean. Minimal, versatile, and effortlessly standout.

Perfect for days when you want comfort without losing intention.

title: Regen Zone “Lord Of War” Leather Jack
body_html:
A rare Regen Zone piece with heavy crest detailing and sculpted hardware.

The Lord Of War jacket blends vintage motorsport energy with modern street culture — crafted in a muted sage-green leather that feels both archival and futuristic.

Bold embroidery, crest detailing, and sculpted metal buckles give the jacket its collectible edge. The cropped silhouette sits clean on the body, making it easy to style with cargos, denim, or elevated basics.

CAREFULLY CURATED PIECE. ONE-OFF, NO RESTOCK

  • Embroidered REGEN ZONE crest & signature script accents
  • Cropped boxy silhouette
  • Double metal buckle adjusters at waist
  • Full-zip front
  • Inner lining for comfort & structure

Fit

  • True-to-size with a naturally boxy fit

title: Nokia 2720 Retro Flip — Curated By TOL

There’s a reason the flip phone is back. In a world where everything is loud, fast, and always-on, the flip phone has become a quiet rebellion—an object that signals intentionality.

This is not just a device.
It’s culture.
It’s the return of the analog spirit—celebrated by artists, stylists, and the new wave of Gen Z minimalists who understand that less noise means more clarity.

Handpicked by Tug Of Looks for its blend of nostalgia and utility, the Nokia 2720 Retro Flip is the perfect everyday piece if you’re building a lifestyle rooted in discipline, style, and calm.
