title: Travis x Fragment Imagination Shorts
body_html:
A rare graphic piece from Travis Scott and Fragment’s collaborative universe.

Cut in a lightweight, easy-drape fabric, these shorts balance comfort with statement energy — blending Travis’ raw visual language with Fragment’s clean, minimal edge.

Featuring the signature eagle motif and blue Fragment-style typography, the silhouette lands slightly oversized with a relaxed rise, making it perfect for warm weather layering, tees, and effortless street looks.

A collectible for anyone who follows modern hip-hop fashion, Japanese design cues, and the evolving culture around Travis’ world.

Easy to wear, hard to find.

title: Kith “Just Us” Mesh L/S Tee
body_html:
This long-sleeve mesh tee blends sport-inspired texture with street luxury, delivering a piece that feels bold and easy  

Crafted with a breathable open-knit mesh and finished with contrast sleeves, hem striping and the signature “Just Us” typography. The silhouette lands relaxed with a soft drape — perfect for styling over a vest, tee or worn solo for a confident, editorial look.

A collector’s piece for anyone who appreciates New York street culture, clean graphics and effortless layering.

title: 14oz Bone Denim Jorts
body_html:
Cut from heavyweight 14oz aged denim, these jorts carry the raw attitude of early–2000s street culture with a modern, sculpted silhouette.

The washed-black finish is treated for depth, while the bone graphic detailing on both legs adds a bold, underground edge — the kind of piece that speaks before you do.

Designed to sit effortlessly on the waist, the fit is relaxed, structured, and intentionally long, giving you that clean, confident drop that works with tees, hoodies, and fitted tops.

Every fade, crease, and mark is intentional. Nothing about these is accidental.

title: Playboi Carti “F**K STAR” Leather Hat
body_html:
A cult-status accessory pulled straight from the underground.

This piece blends distressed luxury with Carti’s signature anti-mainstream energy  

Crafted from textured black leather, the design features raised metal stars arranged across the crown, adding weight, edge, and attitude. It’s bold, but in the Carti way — dark, rebellious, and quietly elite.

Details:

  • Premium textured leather finish
  • Heavy metal star studs
  • Structured front panel for a sharp silhouette
  • Adjustable fit
  • Street-lux aesthetic inspired by Carti’s “F**K STAR” era

 

Wear it with: oversized tees, leather, cargos, or anything black.

This hat instantly turns a simple fit into a statement.

title: Dragon Ryder Boots
body_html:
Built with a sculptural, collapsed silhouette, the Dragon Ryder Boots carry the raw attitude of underground European leatherwork. The upper is cut from thick, distressed black leather that naturally folds and creases, giving each pair a lived-in, battle-ready presence. A reinforced lug sole anchors the boot with weight and stability, while the side zip and riveted strap detail complete the utilitarian edge.

Designed for statement wearers, these boots sit between art object and armor — the kind of piece that transforms wide denim, cargos, or layered fits into a full look.

Carefully sourced and curated by Tug Of Looks, a Nigeria-based premium fashion store.

title: 3D Printed Jeans — Archive 2010
body_html:
A rare archival denim from where trompe-l’oeil printing met rugged workwear silhouettes. This pair features a full 3D illusion print: layered belts, distressed fades, leather textures, and surreal detailing that feels sculpted rather than printed. A piece that blurs reality and fabrication.

Cut in a straight-leg profile, these jeans carry that early-2010s avant-street energy conversation-starting, unmistakably niche.

Details:

– 3D trompe-l’oeil full-body print

– Straight-leg cut

– Archive 2010 design

– Distressed + leather illusion detailing

– True collector’s denim

title: Project G/R Baggy Denim Jeans
body_html:
A wide-leg silhouette built with intention — heavy, structured denim that collapses into natural stacks and movement. Project G/R pushes functionality into style, with oversized rear pockets, contrast stitching, and a subtle yellow emblem that marks its industrial identity.

Made for the ones who prefer shape, volume, and presence in their denim. Whether worn high on the waist or slung low for that underground edge, this pair carries the kind of attitude that doesn’t need introduction.

title: Nine Inch Nails “Downward Spiral” L/S Tee
body_html:
A long sleeve that feels like a bootleg poster from the darkest corner of a NIN show.

Washed black cotton with a huge distorted face graphic from the “Downward Spiral” era, cracked like it’s been through years of loud rooms and bad decisions. Logos and symbols run down the sleeves and hem, giving it that industrial, tour–merch attitude without feeling costume-y.

title: WDW LIBERTY EMBROIDERED BOMBER JACKET
body_html:
This bomber is a fully embroidered time-capsule: the Statue of Liberty across the chest, eagles, flags and bold “PELLE” panels, with portraits of Black leaders and “WHO DECIDES WAR” stitched into the back. Every line of thread feels like a question about power, freedom and who gets to enjoy both.

Built from heavyweight leather with padded quilting, ribbed cuffs and hem, it has that cropped, boxy silhouette that sits perfectly over a hoodie or tee. The red, green and gold stitching hits hard against the black body – you don’t have to say a word, the jacket does the talking.

title: Enfants NIGHT SKETCH JACKET
body_html:
Born from the underground and crafted with intent, the Night Sketch Jacket carries a hand-drawn back illustration that feels like a scene stolen from a dream — or a memory you’re not supposed to have.

Cut from durable faux leather with a structured silhouette, the piece blends quiet detail with attitude:

• Embroidered ENFANTS chest mark

• Silver hardware with industrial zippers

• Elasticated side hems for a shaped fit

• Full graphic artwork on the back panel

• Smooth inner lining for all-day comfort

title: Arc Split Zipper Denim – Jet Black
body_html:
The Arc Split Zipper Denim in Jet Black takes the classic straight-leg shape and mutates it into something sharper, more architectural. Full-length metal zippers arc from hip to hem, allowing the legs to open, flare, collapse or stack depending on your mood. The result is a pair of jeans that behaves almost like a living garment — shifting shape as you move.

High-rise structure. Heavyweight matte denim. A back arc zipper that frames the silhouette with a clean, futuristic curve. Whether worn zipped tight for a straight fall or unzipped for that draped puddle effect, these jeans create a presence you can’t replicate with anything else.

title: MOWA Tech Hoodie
body_html:
A study in geometry from Mowalola Ogunlesi’s world — blending rebellion, speed, and precision.

The Mowa Tech Hoodie features a cropped, engineered fit, a bold chest graphic, and a double-knit fabric designed to stay firm without restricting movement.

Structured, functional, and built for everyday rotation.

  • Iconic MOWA front graphic
  • Technical double-knit body
  • Structured frame with flexible movement
  • Minimal detailing, high durability
  • Designed by Mowalola Ogunlesi

title: Geo-basket Sneaker
body_html:
This Geo-basket sneaker channels the avant-garde energy of directional fashion — oversized tongue, geometric lines, and a distinct red/cream color story.

Built from smooth leather with a structured profile, it delivers height, attitude, and a silhouette that stands out in motion.

Designed for the ones who prefer shape over hype.

  • Premium leather upper
  • Iconic geometric panel construction
  • Elevated high-top build
  • Comfortable padded interior
  • Ridged rubber outsole 

Carefully sourced and curated by Tug Of Looks, a Nigeria-based premium fashion store.

title: HARLEY DAVIDSON Vintage Cut-Off Tee
body_html:
A raw Harley-Davidson vintage tee reworked into a cropped, sleeveless silhouette.

Electric flame graphics ignite the front, while distressing adds authentic grit.

Built for those who prefer pieces with history, energy, and attitude.

  • Reconstructed sleeveless fit
  • Flame and Harley-Davidson emblem
  • Distressed finish
  • Soft vintage cotton
  • Limited availability

title: Polizei Baby Tee
body_html:
Materials

Made of 100% cotton, this T-shirt offers superior comfort and breathability.

Design

Features a "Polizei" print on the chest and an embroidered logo on the back of the neck, with a ribbed crew neck and straight hem.

Fit

The T-shirt has a small, baby fit that combines style and comfort.

title: Industrial Spike Runners
body_html:
Engineered with a brutalist edge, the Industrial Spike Runners bring raw underground energy to a classic trail silhouette. Built on an exaggerated lug sole fitted with metallic spike detailing, this pair blends utility with chaos—giving you a piece that feels lifted straight from the subculture.

Mesh and synthetic overlays create depth and shadow across the upper, while the heavy sole design delivers that distorted, industrial profile. These are not everyday sneakers. They’re a statement. A texture. A mood.

Wear them with wide-leg cargos, distressed denim, or layered technical fits.

Details:

  • Heavy-duty spiked outsole
  • Sculpted trail-inspired midsole
  • Mesh + synthetic upper
  • Underground/industrial aesthetic
  • Fits true to size

title: Echo Fighters Knit Top
body_html:
The Echo Fighters Knit features a bold black-and-ivory silhouette graphic—two figures frozen in a moment of confrontation, like a scene paused inside a ring. Textured, heavyweight knit construction gives it a structured drape, while the cropped, relaxed cut makes it easy to layer over shirts, tees, or nothing at all.

Designed for wardrobes that lean into narrative and mood, this piece stands out without trying too hard.

title: 8 Motocore Padded Hoodie
body_html: A statement piece built for the bold. The 8 Motocore Padded Hoodie reimagines classic streetwear through a futuristic lens — merging biker-inspired paneling with exaggerated structure and an oversized silhouette. Crafted from heavyweight cotton with contrast padded inserts, it delivers both comfort and presence. The signature “8” emblem across the chest and back adds a graphic punch, symbolizing infinite motion and individuality.

title: UNDEFEATED LOGO WALLET
body_html:
The Undefeated Logo Wallet carries street precision in a refined, compact form. Crafted with a textured exterior and finished with the iconic Five Strikes insignia, it blends function with legacy. The interior layout keeps essentials organized without bulk, making it an effortless piece for daily rotation.

A reminder that simplicity doesn’t mean silence, it’s just confidence without noise.

Details:

  • Textured blue exterior
  • Embossed Undefeated “Five Strikes” logo
  • Compact bi-fold design
  • Multiple card and cash slots
  • Comes with branded Undefeated box

title: CH Cross Knit Beanie
body_html: The Chrome Cross Knit Beanie channels quiet rebellion through texture and detail. Hand-knit from soft heavyweight yarn, it features a raised cross emblem and metallic hardware accent that add subtle edge without excess.

title: Carbon Drift Bell Bottoms
body_html:
A sculptural denim silhouette inspired by motion and decay. The Carbon Drift Bell Bottoms are cut from heavyweight washed black denim, carrying a lived-in patina that catches light like smoke. The flare is exaggerated but balanced, widening from the knee into a grounded sweep that frames the footwear and alters the wearer’s stance.

Each pair is uniquely distressed — no two fade alike — giving it the depth of an archive piece. Finished with a mid-to-high waist, oxidized rivets, and reinforced seams, this piece merges industrial precision with raw sensuality. Designed to be worn with intention, whether layered under cropped jackets or heavy knits.

title: YZY Vultures L/S Tee
body_html:
Minimal, militant, and unmistakably Ye. The Vultures long sleeve embodies the stripped-down post-apocalyptic aesthetic of the YZY era; washed black cotton, raw hems, and an oversized cut that moves between silence and statement.

The front carries a faint crest motif — subtle, almost ghost-printed — while the back reveals the full VULTURES insignia: a double-headed eagle rendered in tonal ink, symbolizing strength, duality, and rebirth. A collector’s piece from the most elusive chapter of Yeezy’s design language.

title: Goers Studio “Unforgettable Painters” Pillbox Hat
body_html:
A tribute to jazz, rebellion, and the artistry of imperfection. The Unforgettable Painters pillbox hat from Goers Studio captures the brand’s nostalgic devotion to timeless culture — embroidered with the words “The Jazz Assembly — Celebrating the Utmost Beauty of Jazz.”

Constructed from durable cotton twill with a structured pillbox silhouette, it fuses military precision with artistic nonchalance. The top panel features printed imagery reminiscent of mid-century jazz posters — an echo of rhythm, freedom, and creative fire.

title: Eye of Truth Tee
body_html:
A visual meditation on awareness and perception. The Eye of Truth tee from House of Error reinterprets the ancient all-seeing symbol through a raw, contemporary lens. Constructed from heavyweight cotton in a soft sand tone, it carries a raised applique motif — a sunburst eye that evokes illumination, inner clarity, and the power of sight beyond sight.

The oversized silhouette is deliberately unstructured; relaxed, unbothered, yet commanding.

title: “Garden of Eden” Jersey Tee
body_html:
A poetic clash between the sacred and the street. The Garden of Eden tee reimagines classic jersey form through symbolic embroidery—delicate florals intertwined with the number 12, a recurring Derschutze motif representing cycles, creation, and divine order.

Crafted from heavyweight cotton with a structured drape, the V-neck silhouette sits between relaxed and intentional—layered or standalone. Embroidered branches bloom across the chest, blending faith, fragility, and design precision into a single narrative.

Details:

  • Oversized boxy fit
  • Embroidered floral detailing across chest
  • Raised “12” print motif
  • Ribbed V-neck collar
  • 100% premium cotton

 

Styling Insight:

Pair with muted trousers or cargoes to keep focus on the embroidery. Works seamlessly in minimal or maximal fits—depending on the frequency you’re tuned to.

title: KITH Checkered Satin Dayton Combo Pullover
body_html: The KITH Checkered Satin Dayton Combo Pulloveris a standout piece that merges retro athletic aesthetics with modern streetwear sensibilities. Crafted from custom checkered satin fabric, this pullover features a color-blocked composition, ribbed neckline, and elasticated cuffs and hem for a comfortable fit. Mesh paneling adds breathability, while embroidered KITH branding throughout elevates the design.

title: THUG CLUB Old Glory Tee
body_html: The THUG CLUB Old Glory T-shirt in Black is a bold graphic staple that channels rebellious spirit through clean streetwear execution. Crafted from premium heavyweight cotton, this tee features a boxy, oversized fit and dropped shoulders for that effortless off-duty vibe. The standout element? A powerful “Old Glory” inspired flag graphic printed across the back or chest (depending on the drop), blending Americana symbolism with THUG CLUB’s raw, underground aesthetic. Subtle logo hits and tonal stitching round out the design, making it more than just a tee.

title: HS Scoreboard Long-Sleeve Tee ‘Ecru’
body_html:
A visual statement from Hellstar’s ongoing exploration of faith, performance, and identity. The HS Scoreboard Long-Sleeve Tee ‘Ecru’ features a digital dot-matrix scoreboard graphic reading “PATH TO PARADISE,” with “Hellstar” triumphing over “Opponents”

Crafted from premium cotton in a soft ecru tone, it carries bold pixel graphics down both sleeves and a back print of a fragmented crucifix, symbolizing the tension between heaven and earth that defines Hellstar’s world.

Structured with a relaxed, slightly boxy fit for a modern streetwear silhouette, this piece channels both rebellion and redemption — a collectible for believers in form and frequency alike.

title: Black Box S-D-Runner Mule X
body_html: A sleek, monochrome take on a sculptural silhouette, these unisex mules reimagine the iconic S-D-RUNNER-X sneaker. The curve of the hand-treated matte upper, made from soft PU, is echoed in the meticulous stitching, as well as the sole – note the embossed Oval D branding wrapping beneath it.

title: RS Safety-Pin Metallic Knot Charm
body_html:
A reinterpretation of punk minimalism through industrial elegance with this Safety-Pin Metallic Knot Charm Bracelet.

Crafted in high-polish silver-tone metal, each twisted knot links together to form a bold chain anchored by an oversized safety-pin pendant engraved with the signature “R” emblem. The result; a statement piece that blurs rebellion and refinement.

title: EME CLUB KNIT JERSEY TOP
body_html:
A reinterpretation of vintage football nostalgia through a contemporary lens. The EME CLUB Knit Jersey Top fuses the spirit of classic athletic wear with modern craftsmanship — featuring a breathable open-weave knit in Argentina’s iconic sky-blue and white stripes. The bold “10” print nods to legends of the game, while the textured collar and sleeve hems add a refined edge that balances casual and archival energy.

  • Lightweight crochet-style knit with airy texture
  • Classic polo collar with contrast cuffs
  • Signature EME CLUB chest embroidery
  • Relaxed retro fit for layering or solo wear
  • Composition: Cotton-blend knit
  • Model wears size L for a loose silhouette

 

Style Notes:

Pair it with washed denim or tailored trousers to channel that vintage-meets-modern balance — nostalgic yet forward.

title: AFGK Faux Leather Vest
body_html:
A rework of varsity energy through a leather lens.

This AFGK (A Few Good Kids) vest blends the audacity of street luxury with the precision of tailored design — crafted from premium faux leather with a deep black finish and front zip closure. The oversized red “Afewgoodkids” emblem across the chest seals its identity: loud, unapologetic, and rooted in youth rebellion.

Pair it over a tee, hoodie, or nothing at all  it carries presence either way.

title: ROUGHPLAY “Battle Wounds” Cut-Off Tee
body_html:
The Roughplay “Battle Wounds” Graphic Tee captures chaos in motion — a visual storm of flames, grit, and rebellion.

Cut from premium heavy cotton with a hand-distressed neckline and studded embellishments, it carries a bold front-and-back graphic featuring the one-eyed monster motif and Roughplay’s “Band-Aid for the Battle Wounds” insignia. The oversized drop-shoulder silhouette delivers that post-apocalyptic street feel — dramatic yet wearable.

title: THUG CLUB DISTRESSED SWEATSHORTS
body_html:
Crafted from heavyweight cotton with raw-edge detailing, the THUG CLUB Distressed Sweatshorts embody a lived-in, post-street luxury feel.

Washed in deep charcoal and finished with hand-frayed seams, each pair carries a sense of rebellion and quiet precision. Featuring tonal embroidery and the THUG CLUB insignia, these shorts merge utility with subcultural edge.

  • Elastic waistband with tonal drawstring
  • Exposed seam distressing
  • Dual back pockets
  • Signature TC logo patch
  • Relaxed fit / above-knee cut
  • 100% cotton

title: The Boar Theory Tee
body_html:
A washed black cotton tee carrying the weight of irony and decay.

The Boar Theory Tee features a dual-side print — an animal silhouette distorted through shadow, evoking rebellion and playfulness.

Each piece is cut boxy and sun-faded to feel like a remnant from a forgotten decade, pulled straight from the Archive.

title: Melancholy Destroyed Clip Hoodie
body_html:
A heavyweight grey fleece hoodie built on the tension between refinement and decay.

The Melancholy Destroyed Clip Hoodie features a cropped, boxy silhouette with a distressed hem, exposed fleece lining, and a raw front closure secured by a single metallic clip  

Red serif lettering runs across the chest — a nod to disillusioned youth, to beauty found in collapse. Each piece is washed and frayed to create a lived-in texture that feels deeply personal, like something pulled from an artist’s memory.

Pair with tailored trousers or aged denim. It exists best when styled with contradiction.

title: KAPITAL KOUNTRY LEATHER STRAP
body_html:
Handcrafted from premium cowhide leather and detailed with signature KOUNTRY beadwork, this statement belt captures Kapital’s rugged craftsmanship and playful Americana roots. Each stud and bead is placed by hand, making no two pieces exactly alike. Designed to age beautifully with wear — a true collectible for those who understand Kapital’s cult appeal.

Details

  • 100% genuine leather
  • Handmade beaded detailing
  • Adjustable buckle closure
  • Width: 4 cm
  • Made in Japan

title: NY Noodle Akimbo Hoodie
body_html:
NY Noodle Akimbo Zip-Up Hoodie

Wrap yourself in urban attitude and cozy street style with the NY Noodle Akimbo Zip-Up Hoodie — a fresh drop from Akimbo Club NY that’s quickly becoming a fan favorite. Designed for those who live life unapologetically bold, this Akimbo NY Hoodie combines comfort, durability, and downtown edge in one sleek package.

title: Waxed Flare Denim Jeans
body_html:
A structured flare denim finished with a subtle wax coating that catches light in motion. The silhouette is built to elongate the legs and add presence — straight through the thigh with a controlled flare through the hem. Slight wrinkling and texture at the knee create depth without effort.

The result is a pair of jeans that feel lived-in, cinematic, and unmistakably confident.

Easy to style. Hard to ignore.

Details

  • Mid-rise waist with standard 5-pocket construction
  • Light wax finish for a soft sheen effect
  • Natural crease texture across thigh + knee
  • Controlled flare from knee to hem
  • Black hardware + tonal stitching
  • True to size (size up only for relaxed waist fit)

 

Styling Notes

Pairs naturally with white tanks, boxy tees, cropped jackets, oversized knits, and leather footwear.

Let the flare do the talking.

title: “Gloria” Halftime Performance Varsity Jacket
body_html:
A statement varsity jacket inspired by a historic stadium-level halftime performance moment. The piece features bold patches, contrast color blocking, and heavyweight embroidery. Built to feel like a collectible rather than just another jacket.

The silhouette has a slightly relaxed fit with a structured shoulder and cinched waist, giving the body presence without effort. Satin-finished body with faux leather sleeves for texture play. A jacket designed to be seen, even when you’re quiet.

title: OBSIDIAN STEP DERBY
body_html:
A modern re-imagination of the classic derby silhouette. Built with a deep black, full-grain upper and anchored on an exaggerated ridge sole that adds quiet height and presence. The rounded toe offers a soft sculptural shape, while the slim lace system keeps the profile clean.

Minimal. Precise. Intentional.

Details

  • Premium matte black leather upper
  • Low-profile derby lace structure
  • Reinforced stitch panels for durability
  • Sculpted industrial outsole with tread grip
  • Custom metal lace hardware accent
  • True-to-size fit

title: SAINT ‘Time is Eternal’ Tee
body_html:
• Saint MXXXXXX cotton T-shirt
  • Ribbed crew-neck, printed at front and back, dropped shoulders 
  • Slips on
  • 100% cotton
  • Hand wash

title: Harley Davidson Skull Cap
body_html:
A piece born from rebellion and the road.

The Harley Davidson Skull Cap embodies that signature Americana grit — the kind that outlasts seasons and systems. Crafted in midweight stretch cotton, its snug fit and tonal finish make it a timeless layering essential for both riders and nonconformists.

The orange-and-black Harley insignia sits proudly at the front  an emblem of movement, identity, and freedom — bridging vintage motorwear with today’s underground street language.

title: Project G/R 3-Layered Sweatpants
body_html:
A multi-dimensional silhouette built for form, comfort, and quiet defiance.

The Project G/R 3-Layered Sweatpants merge three distinct fabric tones — grey, navy, and jet black into one cohesive structure. Designed with a stacked waistband illusion and contrast drawstrings, it creates a layered visual depth without sacrificing ease of movement.

Minimal yet assertive, it carries Project G/R’s signature embroidery on the left thigh and precision side stripes for a subtle athletic edge. Every seam, tone, and stitch reflects that in-between space where sportwear meets avant-street

title: Doncare Triple Black Leather Jersey
body_html:
• Faux leather "88" patch
  • Mesh design
  • V neck
  • Oversized fit
  • 100% polyester

title: 6Crayon Weave Leopard Baseball Hat
body_html:
A bold reinterpretation of the classic cap; textured weave, wild-print attitude.

This isn’t just a leopard hat; it’s a statement of controlled chaos. The structured build balances the playful pattern with street sensibility, making it wearable across moods and moments.

Details

  • Premium woven cotton
  • Embroidered “C” front logo
  • Adjustable leather strap
  • Leopard weave pattern finish
  • Unisex fit

 

Style note: pairs best with muted tones or all-black fits — let the print speak for itself.

title: Bad Blood Hoodie - Mustard
body_html: The Bad Blood Hoodie channels that vintage athletic energy — featuring varsity-style patches, stripe detailing across the sleeves, and “91” embroidered on the back. Built from heavyweight cotton fleece for structure and warmth. Finished with “Bad Blood” embroidery on the chest and a signature patch near the hem.

title: Strike Boots 001
body_html:
Built for impact. The Strike Boots 001 merge utilitarian edge with refined minimalism. Constructed with heavy-duty rubber outsoles and reinforced stitching, they deliver durability without compromising silhouette. A true statement piece for those who move differently — rugged, structured, and unapologetically bold.


• Thick lug sole for superior traction
• Smooth matte finish with lace-up closure
• Cushioned inner lining for all-day comfort
• True-to-size fit

Designed for the streets. Engineered for the stride.

title: Armored Flare Camo Pants
body_html:
The Armored Flare Camo Pants reinterpret the traditional military silhouette through a contemporary lens — merging tactical durability with street-level boldness.

Crafted from heavyweight cotton twill in a deep woodland camo, the pants feature armored-style ribbed paneling across the knees, reinforced seams for structure, and flared hems with functional zip openings for adjustable stacking. An engineered V-panel at the thigh and contrast patchwork detailing give it a sculpted, angular profile reminiscent of moto gear.

Designed for everyday combat — whether in the city or off-grid.

title: Crtz Paneled Rugby Top
body_html:
Built with the spirit of team and territory.

The Crtz Paneled Rugby Top combines classic athletic structure with Corteiz’s signature militant edge. Crafted from heavyweight cotton with contrast navy panels along the sleeves and shoulders, it carries an embroidered Corteiz crest at the chest and bold Corteiz logo print across the front.

A clean spread collar, ribbed cuffs, and embroidered “18” detail at the back finish off the look — a nod to underground London energy and unity through code.

This premium men’s polo shirt is available to buy online in Nigeria with secure checkout and nationwide delivery.

title: Liputa Boots
body_html:
• The Akomi Liputa Boots are handmade with premium cowhide leather and anchored by a thick rubber sole built for both city walks and off-grid pace. Each pair comes with five interchangeable lace sets, allowing you to shift tone—from muted to loud—depending on your mood or fit.

    Details:
    • Handmade artisanal construction
    • Premium full-grain cowhide leather
    • Heavy-duty rubber sole for traction and comfort
    • Comes with 5 sets of contrast laces
    • Designed for statement versatility

    Fit: True to size with a roomy toe box.

    Style tip: Rotate lace colors with tonal or contrast fits to express new energy each wear.

title: Cut Hem Skater Denim Shorts
body_html:
A relaxed silhouette meets raw energy. These washed-blue skater shorts are cut from mid-weight denim with a soft vintage feel and feature a raw, unfinished hem for that lived-in edge. Designed to sit just above the knee — loose, effortless, and ready to move.

  • Mid-blue wash with faded tone
  • Cut hem with subtle fray detailing
  • Relaxed skater fit
  • 5-pocket construction
  • Button and zip closure

 

Styling note: pairs easily with oversized tees or boxy shirts for that off-duty street uniform.

title: [ Shine ] HK Tabi Clog
body_html: The upper of this “SHINE” split-toe mule shoe is made of top-grain cowhide/suede and decorated with stitching resembling sun rays. The shoe shape has been adjusted to be flatter than conventional tabi and mule shoes. The entire shoe last has undergone numerous subtle adjustments to achieve an elegant yet everyday look. As always, the outsole uses Vibram Xstrex anti-slip rubber.

title: Animal Print Belt
body_html:
This belt reimagines everyday utility with an edge. Crafted in premium canvas with a cow-inspired animal print, it strikes the balance between streetwear energy and offbeat luxury. The polished silver buckle and leather trim details elevate its raw, graphic aesthetic—making it more than just an accessory but a finishing touch to any fit.

Pair it with relaxed denim, oversized tees, or layered streetwear silhouettes—it’s the kind of belt that turns a look into a story.

  • Canvas body with leather detailing
  • Adjustable silver buckle closure
  • Signature Stüssy streetwear influence
  • One size fits most

title: Retro 1991 Represent FEARLESS Hoodie
body_html:
A statement piece that blends raw energy with vintage grit. Crafted in deep charcoal brown, this heavyweight hoodie features a bold front graphic of a roaring bear with wings — a symbol of strength and defiance. The “FEARLESS” banner cuts across the chest in distressed teal and bone-white, giving it that retro tour-merch feel.

Finished with ribbed cuffs, kangaroo pocket, and subtle Represent branding, it’s built for those who move with courage and refuse to blend in. Soft fleece lining ensures comfort, while the oversized fit adds that effortless streetwear silhouette.

Details:

  • Heavyweight cotton fleece
  • Oversized vintage cut
  • Screen-printed “FEARLESS” artwork
  • Kangaroo pocket with Represent woven tab
  • Ribbed cuffs & hem

title: Fractured Patchwork Flare Jeans
body_html:
A statement piece that bridges vintage grit with contemporary edge. These jeans feature a relaxed, wide-leg silhouette with exaggerated flare hems for a bold flow. The medium-wash denim is treated with fading and whiskering, paired with raw distressing and reinforced patchwork repairs that add depth and character. Visible hand-stitched detailing frames each patch, amplifying the artisanal feel. Designed with classic five-pocket styling, a mid-rise waist, and a slightly slouched fit, they balance rugged utility with avant-garde streetwear appeal.

Perfect for those who embrace individuality, these jeans channel archival workwear codes reimagined for the modern wardrobe.

title: Aywter Bleeding Eye Jacket
body_html:
The AYWTER Jacket is more than outerwear — it’s statement. Cut in a relaxed, oversized silhouette, the jacket is built from heavyweight washed denim with a corduroy collar for contrast and structure.

 

Across the body, fragmented typography collides with fractured webbing and a bleeding eye motif — a print that feels raw, unfinished, and intentionally imperfect. Every detail carries a sense of disruption, making the piece feel more like an artifact than clothing.

  • Heavyweight washed denim construction
  • Corduroy contrast collar
  • Oversized, relaxed fit
  • Distressed + fragmented graphic print
  • Button front closure

title: Cross Patch Flare Denim
body_html:
Reconstructed from contrasting washes, these denim pants break symmetry with a deliberate clash of light, mid, and deep indigo panels. White leather cross appliqués mark the fabric like cultural graffiti—symbols stitched into memory. A relaxed straight-leg cut holds its shape while the panel inserts add dimension, flaring slightly at the hem. Faded through the thighs for a worn-in authenticity, each pair carries the look of something unearthed rather than newly made.

This isn’t just denim but it’s a statement on duality, conflict, and balance. Designed for those who understand that imperfection and patchwork aren’t flaws but identity.

title: Skull Rivet Backpack – Noir Edge
body_html:
Dark, sleek, and unapologetically bold. The Skull Rivet Backpack takes a classic street silhouette and pushes it into darker territory. Constructed from durable textured leather, its surface is armored with silver-tone rivets and anchored by a sculpted skull emblem that sets the tone—rebellion refined.

A double-compartment build adds function to the edge, with a lower zip pocket for essentials and a spacious main chamber for everyday carry. Padded straps balance comfort with utility, while the studded detailing makes it less of a bag and more of a statement.

  • Textured black leather exterior
  • Silver-tone rivet detailing throughout
  • Sculpted skull emblem on front
  • Dual zip compartments with metal hardware
  • Adjustable padded straps

title: Stone-wash Moto Denim Jeans
body_html:
These jeans reimagine vintage moto culture through a streetwear lens. Crafted from heavyweight denim with a distressed stone-wash finish, the fit is relaxed yet structured, designed to stack naturally over sneakers. Intricate paneling and tonal embroidery across the knees and back add a futuristic, armor-like detail — balancing functionality with style.

  • Heavyweight washed denim
  • Paneled knee and rear detailing with stitched graphic motifs
  • Relaxed straight-leg fit with natural stacking
  • Subtle faded treatment for a worn-in edge

 

A statement piece that merges utility with attitude, these jeans are built for movement and presence.

title: BAPE Logo Tote Bag
body_html:
The BAPE Logo Tote Bag is a staple from the streetwear giant, A Bathing Ape. Constructed from sturdy canvas, it carries the instantly recognizable Ape Head logo and block text branding — a symbol that’s defined generations of street culture.

Its generous size makes it the perfect everyday carry, whether for city errands, a quick gym run, or layering into a fit as a statement accessory. Navy contrast handles and base reinforce durability while adding subtle edge.

Details:

  • Sturdy canvas body
  • Signature A Bathing Ape logo print
  • Contrast navy base & handles
  • Spacious, multi-use design
  • Neutral tones for versatile styling

 

Why it matters:

Not just a tote — it’s a piece of history. BAPE’s logo items are more than accessories; they’re cultural artifacts that continue to shape modern streetwear.

title: ADWYSD Logo Jeans
body_html:
The ADWYSD Logo Jeans embody a statement beyond clothing — a mantra stitched into the culture: Always Do What You Should Do. Cut from durable heavyweight denim with a relaxed straight fit, they’re designed for both presence and ease.

Contrasting white stitching highlights the clean construction, while the oversized back pocket print serves as both design and philosophy. Subtle logo detailing on the front keeps it balanced, making these jeans versatile enough to move from everyday wear to statement looks.

Details:

  • Heavyweight denim with relaxed fit
  • Elasticated waistband with drawstring for comfort
  • Contrast white stitching
  • Large back pocket with “Always Do What You Should Do” print
  • Small embroidered front logo
  • Black

title: J.M Basquiat Archive Backpack
body_html:
A backpack reimagined as a canvas. Featuring the iconic hand-drawn sketches and cryptic symbols of Jean-Michel Basquiat, this piece blurs the line between art and utility. The cream leather body is covered in Basquiat’s raw visual language — teeth, crowns, abstract figures — each marking a fragment of rebellion against conformity.

 

With a structured roll-top silhouette and modern street functionality, it’s more than storage — it’s a collectible work of art you can carry.

  • Details: Off-white leather with Basquiat’s graphic artwork
  • Structure: Roll-top closure with buckle fastenings
  • Interior: Spacious compartment + front pocket storage
  • Fit: Functional street luxury with gallery-grade energy

title: Phantom Wave Shades
body_html:
A statement piece that blurs the line between eyewear and art. The Phantom Wave Shades feature a sculptural silhouette with sharp, batwing-inspired edges and futuristic wraparound frames. A polished silver bridge with flame-like contours cuts across dark tinted lenses, creating a design that feels part cyberpunk, part gothic elegance.

Built for those who don’t just wear sunglasses but command attention with them. Bold, unapologetic, and impossible to ignore — the Phantom Wave is more than eyewear; it’s armor for the avant-garde.

UV-protective lenses

Adjustable nose pads for comfort

One size, unisex fit

title: Drew Washed Logo Denim Jacket
body_html:
Non-stretch denim jacket. Fading throughout.
· Spread collar
· Button closure
· Logo printed at chest and back
· Flap pockets and welt pockets

title: Midnight Reverie Camp Shirt
body_html:
A canvas of chaos frozen in print — this short-sleeve camp shirt pulls its imagery from distorted etchings of revelry and delirium. The front stages a grim celebration, faces twisted in exaggerated joy; the back shifts into darker territory, where demons dance on the edge of nightmare.

Cut from lightweight fabric with a relaxed drape, it wears easy while commanding presence. The monochrome palette keeps it stark, letting the artwork do the talking. A piece that feels less like clothing and more like an archival page torn from a book you weren’t supposed to read.

title: Holy Grail Patchwork Flare Pants
body_html:
Built from contrasting panels of washed denim and coated black fabric, each leg tells a different story. The patchwork construction blends raw edges with precision cuts, while the exaggerated flare creates movement that demands attention. From muted grey to high-shine black, the mix of textures gives the pants an almost deconstructed armor feel.

Designed with a relaxed fit that pools over sneakers, they’re a piece for those who see style as rebellion — imperfect, unpredictable, and impossible to ignore.

title: Project G/R Dual Identity Camo Back Skull Tee
body_html: A piece that speaks in contrasts. The front keeps it minimal with a clean black base and a subtle skull-and-crossbones insignia at the chest — quiet power in a single mark. Flip it around and the story shifts: a full-on woodland camouflage canvas with tonal skulls hidden in the pattern, creating a layered effect of rebellion and disguise. Built from premium cotton with a relaxed fit, this tee balances understatement and statement, depending on which side of you shows.

title: Sumwon Studios Santorini Print Shirt
body_html:
Escape into summer with the Santorini Print Shirt.
